claims: Rec Room is shutting down on June 1, 2026, at noon Pacific Time.
The developer announced the shutdown due to profitability issues and an unsustainable business model.
Rec Room has over 150 million users.
New account creation was blocked immediately following the announcement.
New friend requests were blocked immediately following the announcement.
New Rec Room Plus subscriptions were blocked immediately following the announcement.
The service will go fully dark on June 1, 2026, including the rec.net website.
Snap Inc. has acquired some assets from Rec Room Inc.
Some employees are moving to work on Specs AR eyewear.
According to the GeekWire report and The Verge report, the decision stems from financial challenges in making the platform profitable.
The decision stems from a shift in the VR market.
The official Rec Room blog confirmed that they chose to wind down while still able to do so thoughtfully
